Description
The 1 oz PAMP Suisse Silver Bar – Lakshmi is one of the beautiful silver bars which are produced by the world’s leading precious refiner,
PAMP Suisse
which was founded in 1977 in Ticino which is the southernmost section of Switzerland, and it is a stunningly beautiful area.
These silver bars are released by PAMP Suisse as part of a religious series, in honor of the
Hindu religion
which has a follower of nearly 1.25 billion worldwide.
Departing from the well-known Lady Fortuna, Pamp Suisse introduces a series that gives respect to many religions. Each bar represents a religion, whether it’s a symbol or a portrait, for several different regions. Pamp Suisse is known for excellently packaging their products, each bar is sealed in an assay card that not only protects the bar but also lists the bar’s information such as serial number, purity, etc.
Although the bar itself also contains its authenticity information, such as one ounce .999 pure silver, it is recommended not to remove the bar from its assay card unless you don’t wish to sell it.
The Pamp Suisse one-ounce bar is guaranteed to be pure silver and is molded into a clean-cut bar that is packaged in its assay card.
This 1 oz pamp suisse silver bar is one of the best-sellers among those who are looking to invest in silver items and is also one of the most sought-after bars by collectors. These silver bars are also very aesthetically pleasing and can be considered as works of art due to their striking color combination and the fine details that are engraved into them.
Design of 1 oz PAMP Suisse Silver Bar – Lakshmi
The beautiful Hindu Goddess, Lakshmi graces the obverse side of these PAMP Suisse Lakshmi silver bars.
Goddess Lakshmi is a beautiful goddess who symbolizes prosperity, wealth, love, and the manifestation of beauty. The goddess contains four hands, each representing goals to be attained in human life: dharma, kama, artha, and moksha. Each of these concepts cannot be translated into single word translations, since they are more ideas than actual things. All of these are goals that are to be sought after without sacrificing the other three goals. Lakshmi is elegantly illustrated on the Pamp Suisse one-ounce bar, with all four arms intact, and she is placed in a Lotus flower. The goddess is usually presented with the Lotus, a flower that can bloom in any kind of condition, a wise word that something beautiful can grow out of any circumstance.
The reverse side of these 1 oz silver bars features the depiction of the company’s unique PAMP logo which consists of the words ”PAMP” enclosed inside a four small circle followed by the term “Suisse” just beneath it. The other labels inscribed vertically on the reverse of these silver bars are weight, purity, metal content, assayers mark, and a unique serial number.
Main Highlights of 1 oz Silver Bar – PAMP Suisse Lakshmi
Contains 1 troy oz of .999 fine silver.
Produced by the leading swiss precious refiner, PAMP Suisse.
Each of the silver bars comes with its original own assay card.
Features the Hindu Goddess, Lakshmi on the obverse.
Features the unique PAMP logo along with the weight, purity, metal content, and unique serial number on the reverse.
Each Silver bar is assigned a unique serial number made up of a combination of alphabets and numbers.
